Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 31
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 大泼猴 / The Legends Of Monkey King Episode 24
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 32
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 天地剑心 / Sword and Beloved Episode 7

programme.title: 现在很美丽 / It's Beautiful Now Episode 9
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事。李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫。 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊。 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作。 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓。 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师。 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医。 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备。 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 17
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 33
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 王牌对王牌 第9季 / The King vs The King S9
programme.desc: 《王牌对王牌》是中国浙江卫视原创综艺，节目每期围绕一个主题，由固定MC“王牌家族”队与攻擂嘉宾队展开PK，通过才艺比拼、游戏竞技，决出王牌中的王牌 。Zhejiang TV’s long-running anchor variety show “The King vs The King” returns with an eighth season. Hosted by comedians Shen Teng and Sha Yi, singer-songwriter Hua Chen Yu and actresses Tang Yan and Guan Xiao Tong, the popular show invites celebrities to compete in a series of games to vie for a "trump card", with each episode focusing on a certain theme.

programme.title: 大泼猴 / The Legends Of Monkey King Episode 26
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 现在很美丽 / It's Beautiful Now Episode 11
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事。李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫。 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊。 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作。 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓。 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师。 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医。 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备。 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 869
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季 / Breakfast In China S5 Episode 2
programme.desc: 《早餐中国》第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味。我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹。

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季 / The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2 Episode 11
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 美女与纯情男 / Beauty and Mr Romantic Episode 27

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 869
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 亦舞之城 / Second Chance Romance Episode 13

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 870
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 因 AI 相约 / AI Romance Episode 13
programme.desc: 由袁成杰、余有矿主持，心理咨询师于志凌坐镇的《因AI相约》，是中国首创全新相亲综艺。让AI红娘登场，牵起缘分的红线，用AI独家大数据模型，精准捕捉嘉宾个性，再用AI面具盲选，真诚交流点燃心动瞬间。到底是选择AI推荐，还是倾听内心声音？《因AI相约》用算法助力情缘，让爱情见证最美的邂逅！ “AI Romance” is a dating variety with a spin, marrying scientific AI technology with age-old romance and love! This is China’s first attempt at artificial intelligence experimental dating series and the programme brings on a whole new viewing experience and refreshed feel, for traditional dating varieties.

programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法。透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸、挥霍生活，还贪图更多。母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧。就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演。必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧。一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上。Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 18
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 34
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季 / The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2 Episode 12
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.title: 现在很美丽 / It's Beautiful Now Episode 15
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事。李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫。 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊。 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作。 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓。 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师。 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医。 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备。 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 现在很美丽 / It's Beautiful Now Episode 16

programme.title: 大泼猴 / The Legends Of Monkey King Episode 28
programme.desc:
天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路。他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言。为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中。
A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 34
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.title: 灼灼韶华 / Wild Ambition Bloom Episode 18
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人。陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境。褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小。褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠。陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海。褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人、重诺守信的女商人。This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 奔跑吧特别篇 5 / Keep Running Special Season 5
programme.desc: 奔跑吧特别篇 5》着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望、对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量。节目还是由“奔跑吧”固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务。

programme.title: The $25 Million T. Rex Auction That Fell Apart
programme.desc: Dinosaur fossils have become a high-end collectibles market, with auction prices reaching tens of millions of dollars.

programme.title: Inside Trump's Deal to Reshape Alaska
programme.desc: A mining deal by the Trump administration and a 211-mile road have pitted Wall Street against Alaska residents fearful of the environmental impact. But not everyone is against the Ambler Road project.

programme.title: How Trump's ICE Raids Are Damaging Businesses
programme.desc: New data reveals how the deportation campaign may leave social and economic voids in communities across the nation.

programme.title: Why Space Companies Are Betting Big on Texas
programme.desc: Already home to SpaceX, Blue Origin and recent moon-landers Firefly Aerospace and Intuitive Machines, Texas is quickly becoming the center of the commercial space universe.

programme.title: The Mysterious Rise of China's Desert AI Hubs
programme.desc: A Bloomberg investigation found China is building a small city of AI data centers in a remote desert and looking to buy 115,000 of Nvidia's best chips to power them despite a US export ban.

programme.title: The Race to Build Data Centers in Space
programme.desc: “Data centers in space” may sound like science fiction, but as the SpaceX IPO augurs a space boom, tech giants and startups are betting orbital artificial intelligence is the next frontier.

programme.title: A Dangerous Corner of the Global Shipping Industry
programme.desc: The sinking of the Gulf Livestock 1 was the worst disaster in the history of the live-export trade, an industry made up of about 150 ships with a market value totaling $20 billion to $30 billion.

programme.title: What 10 Years of Brexit Has Cost the UK
programme.desc: In June 2016, the UK voted to leave the European Union. Ten years later, Bloomberg Originals unpacks the economic cost of Brexit and the political forces it unleashed.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance Radio
programme.desc: The economy and the markets are "under surveillance" as we cover the latest in finance, economics and investment. Join Tom Keene, Paul Sweeney, Lisa Mateo, Michael Barr and other guests.

programme.title: Balance of Power

programme.title: Bloomberg BusinessWeek

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 8

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 3
programme.desc: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 1). Emily meets Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei for a rare, in-depth discussion of the startup's origin story.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 4
programme.desc: A Bloomberg Originals series hosted by Emily Chang that goes behind the scenes with founders, influencers and innovators.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 2

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets California's First Couple, Governor Gavin Newsom and Jennifer Siebel Newsom, visiting their home in Marin County and offices in Sacramento to see how they work together.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 7
programme.desc: Emily Chang sits down with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei in a wide-ranging interview discussing his San Francisco roots, the race against OpenAI, the Pentagon standoff and AI's endgame.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 5
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Nobel Prize-winning scientist and University of California, Berkeley, Professor Jennifer Doudna to discuss the origins of CRISPR, other breakthroughs in gene editing and what Silicon Valley gets wrong about the future of biology.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 3
programme.desc: Emily Chang speaks with Microsoft titans Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer and Satya Nadella about the company's journey from scrappy startup to global powerhouse.

programme.desc: Emily Chang speaks with Microsoft titans Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer and Satya Nadella about the company's journey from scrappy startup to global powerhouse.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 5
programme.desc: Emily Chang meets Melinda French Gates in Seattle to discuss how she's navigating her next stage as a philanthropist and investor.

programme.title: The Circuit with Emily Chang Episode 6
programme.desc: Emily Chang goes inside the world of supermodel-turned-entrepreneur Karlie Kloss to explore how she's trying to revive magazine publishing.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing
programme.desc: Liquid Death was founded on the idea of breaking the norms of traditional marketing. We speak to CMO Dan Murphy about the water company's origin as a "sheep in wolf's clothing."

programme.title: Quantum Marketing Episode 2
programme.desc: We speak with Pranav Yadav, CEO of Neuro-Insight, about the marketing intelligence his company is gleaning from neuroscience.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing Episode 3
programme.desc: Lisa McKnight, Mattel's chief brand officer, has been at the forefront of reviving the iconic Barbie. Now the famous toy brand has launched itself beyond store shelves and onto the silver screen.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing Episode 4
programme.desc: McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown discusses the technology, data and effort required to propel the McLaren brand onto the modern F1 stage and into living rooms around the globe.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing Episode 5
programme.desc: Stephan Pretorious, chief technology officer of WPP, unpacks the world of generative artificial intelligence and its potential impact, both positive and negative, on marketing.

programme.title: Quantum Marketing Episode 6
programme.desc: From immersive experiences to live streaming, National Women's Soccer League Chief Marketing and Commercial Officer Julie Haddon discusses the opportunities for growing women's professional sports.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Scientists are developing powerful magnets to enable clean energy sources like fusion. But China's dominance of the supply chain for rare-earth magnets threatens their global availability.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 2
programme.desc: We explore the world of biocomputing-where scientists are laying the foundation for a field that may blur the lines between the biological and synthetic.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Chinese companies dominate the EV battery supply chain and are expanding rapidly outside their home market. Meanwhile, competitors are looking to new chemistries to leapfrog the leading tech.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 2
programme.desc: Humanoid robots that use AI are going mainstream, but they're far from proven. With billions of dollars invested, can they deliver real-world value or will they fall short of the hype?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 3
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 4
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 5
programme.desc: Flooding is rising worldwide, driving a global push for climate adaptation. From tunnels to seawalls to fly farms, can these solutions keep up with accelerating global warming?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer Episode 6
programme.desc: AI's rapid growth is pushing global energy demand skyward, forcing electrical grids to expand and modernize. Now, companies from China to Nigeria are investing in new tech to power the future.

programme.title: Building The Impossible Episode 2
programme.desc: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

programme.title: Building The Impossible Episode 3
programme.desc: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it's incredible engineering; from first oil to today's innovative rigs.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 5
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 6
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild Episode 3
programme.desc: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

programme.title: Canada: A Year In The Wild Episode 4
programme.desc: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild
programme.desc: The end of winter heralds one of the world's greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 2
programme.desc: With the arrival of spring, days grow longer and temperatures rise. However, spring in Alaska is short. Animals have just two months to find food and start a family, while avoiding predators.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 3
programme.desc: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the world's greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 4
programme.desc: Humpback whales return to Alaska's rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

programme.title: Oceans Africa
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 3
programme.desc: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the world's greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

programme.title: Alaska: A Year In The Wild Episode 4
programme.desc: Humpback whales return to Alaska's rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programme.desc: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 3
programme.desc: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 4
programme.desc: Ainsley's street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 5
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the island's unique recipe for pesto.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 6
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

programme.title: Divas Episode 3
programme.desc: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

programme.title: Divas Episode 4
programme.desc: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

programme.title: Divas Episode 5
programme.desc: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

programme.title: Bruce Willis: All American Hero
programme.desc: Bruce Willis became a star with his iconic role as John McClane in Die Hard, leading to a legendary career with over 100 films. Known for his charm and humor, his career faced a tragic setback in 2022.

programme.title: Cher: Sharing Her Story
programme.desc: Step into the world of Cher, an enduring icon whose journey from humble beginnings to superstardom has shaped pop culture for over five decades. A true pioneer, she's dominated music charts, reinvented herself in film, and built a legacy that transcends entertainment. programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitats.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesn't look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher's pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth's fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature's most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: From the Highlands to the Alps, Europe's evocative landscapes are the backdrop for epic wildlife drama. Normally stoic red deer go wild during the rut. Wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot - it's not as nice as it sounds.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the region's dark side.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Complete the trip's final lap in the untamed lands where Australia's interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 4
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 5
programme.desc: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2 Episode 6
programme.desc: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow – but full of monsters.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.desc: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo's biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness' flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters' club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who's honing her survival skills in Brazil's Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe's demise becomes a source of life for the region's vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 3
programme.desc: The auditions conclude as the professional chefs battle for one of the coveted five spots.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 4
programme.desc: The top 15 chefs are drafted into their three teams; the contestants must prepare an all-American smash burger that proves their cooking abilities.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 5
programme.desc: The 14 remaining chefs are tasked with preparing a curry dish that promises to pack a punch with only 30 minutes on the clock; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 6
programme.desc: The 13 remaining chefs channel their vacation vibes when they're tasked with preparing a seafood dish inspired by tropical island cuisine; the winning dish gives the entire team immunity and claims the top-level kitchen for the next challenge.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 7
programme.desc: The chefs are tasked with preparing a next-level international street food dish; the platform never stops moving throughout the challenge.

programme.desc: The remaining chefs butcher and break down various cuts of beef amongst their teams to create sizzling steak dishes; two contestants face elimination as they enter a heated seafood cook-off.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 9
programme.desc: The 10 remaining contestants step into the kitchen with the goal of elevating the traditional pizza into a next-level masterpiece; the winning pizza gains immunity for the whole team and claims the top-level kitchen spot.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 10
programme.desc: Using a bounty of fresh ingredients from the platform, the chef who prepares the best Greek entrée wins immunity for their team.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 11
programme.desc: The eight remaining competitors must work together in teams to create a cohesive three-course meal; with only 30 minutes on the clock, the team with the winning menu remains safe from elimination.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 12
programme.desc: The seven remaining chefs work individually to create Japanese-inspired dishes for their bento boxes; one judge oversees the chefs during the elimination challenge, while two judges blindly taste test their creations.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 13
programme.desc: The six remaining chefs are tasked with recreating a picture perfect dish using just the memory of a reference photo.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 14
programme.desc: The final five chefs must create a dish using a fermented drink called kombucha; two chefs battle for a spot in the semifinals.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 15
programme.desc: In the semi-finals, the final four chefs face a tangy twist as they're tasked with showcasing one of the classic taste elements.

programme.title: Next Level Chef S3 Episode 16
programme.desc: The final three chefs race against the clock to craft a sensational three-course meal; one chef rises to the top and wins the grand prize.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 29
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 43
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 24
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 10
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 天知道 / Fate's Secret Episode 65
programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人、感化世间暴戾的感人故事。剧情强调“善的力量”与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人、充满信念的作品。Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 25
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 267
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 45
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 11
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 969
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 12
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 969
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级夜总会 / Super Nightclub Episode 701
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 725
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 199
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 231
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style Episode 20
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1 Episode 7
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 203
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 204
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.title: 超级夜总会 / Super Nightclub Episode 702
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 726
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style Episode 21
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 32
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 231
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 12
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 27
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 970
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 269
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking one’s unlimited potential.

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 46
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 46

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 / Pretty Dangerous Episode 13
programme.desc: 新型毒品“粉精灵”在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组。三人分别擅长推理、武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织。在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力。故事融合卧底、动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动。As a new drug "Pink Spirit" spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 幸福房屋事件簿 / Haunted House For Sale
programme.desc: 房仲业务安琪突然得知失联多年的父亲留了一间房子给她，不过却始终找不到父亲，房子空置许久，还传出有游民在里面暴毙。就在此时，安琪接下了公司凶宅专案的任务，在她处理一桩桩事故屋的过程中，她逐渐打听到了父亲的下落……。Real estate agent Angel suddenly discovers that her long-lost father has left her a house. However, her father is nowhere to be found, and the house has been left vacant for a long time, rumoured to have vagrants dying inside. Just then, Angel is tasked to sell her company’s haunted houses. As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her father’s whereabouts…

programme.title: 幸福房屋事件簿 / Haunted House For Sale Episode 3
programme.desc: 房仲业务安琪突然得知失联多年的父亲留了一间房子给她，不过却始终找不到父亲，房子空置许久，还传出有游民在里面暴毙。就在此时，安琪接下了公司凶宅专案的任务，在她处理一桩桩事故屋的过程中，她逐渐打听到了父亲的下落……。Real estate agent Angel suddenly discovers that her long-lost father has left her a house. However, her father is nowhere to be found, and the house has been left vacant for a long time, rumoured to have vagrants dying inside. Just then, Angel is tasked to sell her company’s haunted houses. As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her father’s whereabouts…

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 17
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

来自未来的古董店老板毕之和活在现代的宠物医生苏北陆组成合作伙伴，一起踏上寻回古董的时光之旅。不同时期的风土人情、跌宕起伏的人生境遇，在二人的穿针引线间被娓娓道来。在这一过程中，他们收获了跨时空的友情，最终满怀乐观地面对各自的人生。
Su Beilu unexpectedly crosses paths with Bi Zhi, a time traveller from the future, and the two form an unlikely partnership. Through futuristic technology—the Time Elevator—they embark on bizarre adventures through various historical eras. Bi Zhi runs a mysterious antique shop called The Company, and Su Beilu assists him in collecting one antique after another. As their adven...

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: In Shanghai's finance world, Qian Fei clashes with elite investor Li Yifei, while boyfriend Wang Ruohai accepts Liao Shiyu's job offer and grows close to her. Qian Fei witnesses their intimacy and confronts him.

programme.title: 爱情有烟火 / Love Has Fireworks Episode 2
programme.desc: Wang Ruohai ends the relationship. After Li Yifei rescues Qian Fei from harassment, she faces work setbacks, rents out her spare room to ease her mortgage, and finds her new tenant is Li Yifei.

programme.title: 烈焰 / Burning Flames Episode 17
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯。然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶。武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部、妖族、海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族。武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神。

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 17
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 好事成双 / Alliance Episode 19
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛。离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场。面对婚姻、职场、亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心。林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活。

programme.title: 绝命法官 / Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 2202
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 25
programme.desc: 第二十五集天生招揽高哲，高哲不为所动。定垚在高哲提示下去找程凯，并在启堂面前扮作关注初创项目，放手公司其他业务，好令启堂放下戒心。天生发财立品，却遇到终日提起自己从前种种丑事的兆齐，于是设计逼使兆齐贱卖家族资产，以泄心头之恨。海泉病逝，始终看不到明晞名成利就的一刻，明晞悲痛又不忿。定垚有意投资程凯公司，程凯提出没预算限制、没交货期限的条件，小慧为其求情。泽雨终日流连夜店，有天赫然发觉自己正步向父亲的后路。

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 & 今日知多D / Mrs. RevengeWhat's On Today Episode 12
programme.desc: 第12集家谦看出晓彤邀约幸如共膳的用意，向她强调与幸如没有感情瓜葛。幸如一组的塑身衣广告因被曲解成歧视女性而惹来抨击，更有人在宣传活动上滋事；家谦在混乱中救了幸如。雪文趁佩贞拿汤给幸如，故意抹黑幸如；幸如将计就计，想令佩贞讨厌她，讵料……家谦怀疑背后操控广告一事的人是晓彤，前往找她对质，晓彤将家谦对幸如的在意看在眼内……家谦知道幸如被针对全因自己，决定提早公布婚讯，向真正幕后黑手宣战。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 7
programme.desc: 第7集 从芯出发唐芯与身在美国的父亲钱瞻常有联络，感情甚笃；嘉冰却怨恨钱瞻当年未给予万里名份，更抛下唐芯远赴美国。唐芯因父亲之故积极练跑，安多勋察觉不妥欲助她训练，唐芯却指他藉此讨好万里，更断言他绝无可能取代父亲。唐芯执意参加跑步比赛，参赛者需自行承担风险，嘉冰忧心设法阻止，却不果。唐芯上山练跑时迷路中暑，幸获某人相救送院。嘉冰联络钱瞻兴师问罪，钱瞻提出其亲子理念，嘉冰却不以为然。最终，唐芯竟瞒着嘉冰出院参赛……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 230
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 南美潮什么2 / Hipster Tour - South America (Sr.2) Episode 2
programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 命转皇后 / Story of Kunning Palace Episode 2
programme.desc: 第2集雪宁到尤府想找回前世的贴身宫女芳吟，发现她被家人压制，雪宁奋不顾身营救。有刺客想刺杀谢危，雪宁刚好来到而被挟持，雪宁以为谢危想杀她。花灯会上，燕临提到自己快将加冠，让雪宁想起前世冠礼的情况而伤心落泪…

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 2047
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 101
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 呃钱 / Scam Alert! Episode 9
programme.desc: 各类骗案数字持续上升，涉及的款项亦甚夸张。据悉香港每日平均损失达2500万元，每13分钟就有一宗骗案发生……网购、求职、投资、交友应用程序、电话骗案等行骗招数越来越高明，市民要及时提高防骗意识，慎防中伏！主持区永权、萧正楠、李旻芳、梁敏巧网罗不同真实个案，深入了解事主被骗经过，节目还会以故事形式重现个中情节。专家们现身拆解不同犯案手法，协助观众辨识《呃钱》陷阱，避免成为骗徒目标！

programme.desc: 第7集 从芯出发唐芯与身在美国的父亲钱瞻常有联络，感情甚笃；嘉冰却怨恨钱瞻当年未给予万里名份，更抛下唐芯远赴美国。唐芯因父亲之故积极练跑，安多勋察觉不妥欲助她训练，唐芯却指他藉此讨好万里，更断言他绝无可能取代父亲。唐芯执意参加跑步比赛，参赛者需自行承担风险，嘉冰忧心设法阻止，却不果。唐芯上山练跑时迷路中暑，幸获某人相救送院。嘉冰联络钱瞻兴师问罪，钱瞻提出其亲子理念，嘉冰却不以为然。最终，唐芯竟瞒着嘉冰出院参赛……

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 11
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.title: 南美潮什么2 / Hipster Tour - South America (Sr.2) Episode 2
programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 9
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: 第1集港女．野人 开动！何泳芍、陈若思、廖慧仪和胡美贻，先后透过港姐竞选入行，今次一同参与真人骚节目，全方位挑战本地不同难度系数的山野。四位活力主持，无惧上山下海、荒岛求生、攀岩觅路，但原来有人事前全无扎营经验，行山居然不带饮用水？摄制组请来山艺教练、野炊达人、环保战士等教路，仍避不过意外，情况有多惊险？四人一起体验野外露营，「驾到边、瞓到边」的车中泊；亲手炮制串烧原只嫩鸡、巨型鲑鱼等野炊美食……由港女变身「野人」！

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 2203
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 命转皇后 / Story of Kunning Palace Episode 3
programme.desc: 第3集雪宁列入芷衣伴读名单，孟氏气愤。薛远欲给燕家伪造罪证，周寅之成功接近燕临，雪宁猜到前世燕家惨案与寅之有关，提醒他别牵涉燕薛两家之争。雪宁在伴读考试故意乱写以求落选，不料谢危留她成为伴读，她折返找谢危…

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 231
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 8
programme.desc: 第8集 杜拜朱古力的诱惑嘉骢承继父亲的物业，每月收取丰厚租金，还改建名下一物业单位，与友人合办共享空间「开心小栈」，理应经济充裕。嘉冰着嘉骢出资打造金器送赠亲戚，嘉骢却诸多推搪。嘉冰向唐芯问及「开心小栈」的经营状况，察觉不妥，遂暗中监察嘉骢，竟有重大发现，怀疑他花天酒地、为女人大洒金钱，于是与唐芯设法「拯救」嘉骢，却揭开不为人知的真相。嘉冰欲为嘉骢出头追讨损失，却不果，幸而万里、唐芯动员人脉，合力为嘉骢解困……

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 13
programme.desc: 第13集启荣欲剔除家谦的计划失败。幸如因熙妍醉言醉语，得悉家谦结婚在即；家谦独自借酒消愁。苓君高调公开家谦、晓彤婚讯，二人在人前表面恩爱，家谦在人后亦向晓彤表示会为二人关系努力。随着婚讯公开，家谦、熙妍的身分亦曝光……继威为协助其昌的私帮生意赚快钱，不惜利用雪文。雪文继续主动讨好佩贞，又登堂入室宣示主权……幸如好意协助运送继威一组遗下的道具到拍摄现场，到达后却见气氛有异，怀疑继威打算在此向她求婚。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 26
programme.desc: 第二十六集定垚答应投资程凯公司，承诺不会催促进度，程凯喜上眉梢。启堂怀疑大屿山项目的环评报告有蹊跷，找人调查，天生早一步解决，启堂气结。程凯迟迟未能递交智能家居进度，定垚设计刺激程凯，让他乖乖赶工。泽雨认识了来自香港的甘日朗与谢安东，二人计划建立烹饪平台，泽雨决定投资，想不到合作的网红竟然是端儿。在活动上，兆齐口不择言，戏说天生和明晞无子送终。明晞回家后哭崩，问天生信不信报应？

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 102
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 27
programme.desc: 第二十七集端儿看到众筹平台出事的新闻后，答应泽雨合作发展烹饪平台。程凯发现被定垚耍了，大兴问罪，却突然对她有了异样感觉。力晨混入季生集团调查，高哲叮嘱他小心。高哲意外收到思妤来电，思妤工作的环保公司面临倒闭，请求高哲施援手。启堂将智能家居引入傲堂旗下楼盘，取得巨大成功，定垚暗觉不安。其后启堂欲收购程凯的超级电池发展电动车，程凯因决定追求定垚而有保留。泽雨首次在内地过生日，端儿炮制港式小吃庆祝，泽雨感动落泪。

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 8
programme.desc: 第8集 杜拜朱古力的诱惑嘉骢承继父亲的物业，每月收取丰厚租金，还改建名下一物业单位，与友人合办共享空间「开心小栈」，理应经济充裕。嘉冰着嘉骢出资打造金器送赠亲戚，嘉骢却诸多推搪。嘉冰向唐芯问及「开心小栈」的经营状况，察觉不妥，遂暗中监察嘉骢，竟有重大发现，怀疑他花天酒地、为女人大洒金钱，于是与唐芯设法「拯救」嘉骢，却揭开不为人知的真相。嘉冰欲为嘉骢出头追讨损失，却不果，幸而万里、唐芯动员人脉，合力为嘉骢解困……

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 1773
programme.desc: 全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 南美潮什么2 & 今日知多D / Severe Case Decoded & What's On Today Episode 3
programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: 第1集港女．野人 开动！何泳芍、陈若思、廖慧仪和胡美贻，先后透过港姐竞选入行，今次一同参与真人骚节目，全方位挑战本地不同难度系数的山野。四位活力主持，无惧上山下海、荒岛求生、攀岩觅路，但原来有人事前全无扎营经验，行山居然不带饮用水？摄制组请来山艺教练、野炊达人、环保战士等教路，仍避不过意外，情况有多惊险？四人一起体验野外露营，「驾到边、瞓到边」的车中泊；亲手炮制串烧原只嫩鸡、巨型鲑鱼等野炊美食……由港女变身「野人」！

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 13
programme.desc: 第13集启荣欲剔除家谦的计划失败。幸如因熙妍醉言醉语，得悉家谦结婚在即；家谦独自借酒消愁。苓君高调公开家谦、晓彤婚讯，二人在人前表面恩爱，家谦在人后亦向晓彤表示会为二人关系努力。随着婚讯公开，家谦、熙妍的身分亦曝光……继威为协助其昌的私帮生意赚快钱，不惜利用雪文。雪文继续主动讨好佩贞，又登堂入室宣示主权……幸如好意协助运送继威一组遗下的道具到拍摄现场，到达后却见气氛有异，怀疑继威打算在此向她求婚。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 231
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 2203
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.desc: 全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 2049
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 万福金安 & 今日知多D / Wan Fu Jin An & What's On Today Episode 12
programme.desc: 皇后顾清（王艺瑾 饰）遭人陷害，命丧一场精心布局的大火，却意外重生到尚衣局婢女凤卿（方瑾 饰）身上。从高高在上的皇后变成身份卑微的宫女，凤卿没有被悲痛击倒，为了保护妹妹顾婉（吴曼思 饰），亦为查出自己遇害真相、揪出幕后真凶，她决定暂时隐藏锋芒，以凤卿身份在深宫中低调蛰伏。凤卿深知单靠一己之力难以翻案，于是暗中联络身为太医的弟弟顾玹（储子竣 饰）。姐弟二人默契十足，连手在后宫各方势力之间周旋，一边避开重重刁难与陷阱，一边搜集线索，与宫中奸佞斗智斗力。在这场复仇与守护交织的博弈中，凤卿与帝王萧骆（赵华为 饰）再度产生交集。萧骆一直对顾清的「惨死」心存疑窦，更隐约觉得凤卿身上有顾清的影子，因此不断试探她。凤卿面对萧骆亦是百感交集，二人在一次又一次交锋与拉扯之间，逐步解开昔日误会，前世未了的羁绊亦悄然延续。

programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 10
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 地球大神秘 / Shock Mystery (Sr.2) Episode 102
programme.desc: 人类对未知的事物，与生俱来有种好奇心，甚至有人相信，在生活中的一切事物，并非全部可以单从科学物理现像解释得到，即使表面上有可以接受的答案，也未必能够圆满解释所有疑问！《地球大神秘》制作队从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容，都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释，除非呢个世界有「超自然」的存在！节目将会让大家知道不可思议的神秘事物，不但在过去存在，而且目前仍然存在！

programme.title: 命转皇后 / Story of Kunning Palace Episode 4
programme.desc: 第4集姚惜觉得张遮配不上自己，想要退亲，尤月献计，只要散播张遮命中克妻的谣言，姚家即可退亲，姜雪宁听后教训了尤月一顿。姜雪宁让尤芳吟找许文益买下生丝，静候时机。周寅之在侯府暗查时，竟发现了平南王的徽记残片…

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 / Like Mother, Like Daughter Episode 9
programme.desc: 第9集 请秘书为何那样（上）万里的组员何文谦、曾碧池与巫慧慧为表忠心而抵制杨帆，惹起不少事端，文谦更不慎打破价值不菲的展品。万里前往排舞室找物主张太道歉，发现张太与公关界声誉不佳的型男范特栖练舞，表现亲昵。杨帆亦到来，自称为相同目的而来，万里觉得奇怪，藉词阻拦让张太离去。然而，杨帆终究抢先摆平此事。另一方面，万里、杨帆同时聘请秘书，碧池等人报复杨帆，为他物色一位「极品」秘书莫希灵。希灵以为终于有人赏识自己，却意外发现真相……

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 14
programme.desc: 第14集继威早已拜托佩贞骗走雪文，免被雪文坏事。熙妍受浩恩所托帮他追求幸如，意外洞悉继威的求婚大计。雪文察觉被骗，震怒赶至拍摄现场，扬言要公开继威与自己出轨之事……继威向幸如求婚，她无惧群众压力，断言拒绝，更向继威、雪文作出反击……雪文知道继威仍打算跟幸如结婚，恼恨吃醋。美淇最终没有辞职。幸如、家谦推测继威、其昌收受回佣，但苦无实证。幸如故意激怒雪文，要藉此令她供出继威，雪文却忿然道出憎恨幸如的原因。

programme.desc: 第9集 请秘书为何那样（上）万里的组员何文谦、曾碧池与巫慧慧为表忠心而抵制杨帆，惹起不少事端，文谦更不慎打破价值不菲的展品。万里前往排舞室找物主张太道歉，发现张太与公关界声誉不佳的型男范特栖练舞，表现亲昵。杨帆亦到来，自称为相同目的而来，万里觉得奇怪，藉词阻拦让张太离去。然而，杨帆终究抢先摆平此事。另一方面，万里、杨帆同时聘请秘书，碧池等人报复杨帆，为他物色一位「极品」秘书莫希灵。希灵以为终于有人赏识自己，却意外发现真相……

programme.title: 南美潮什么2 / Hipster Tour - South America (Sr.2) Episode 4
programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 命转皇后 / Story of Kunning Palace Episode 4
programme.desc: 第4集姚惜觉得张遮配不上自己，想要退亲，尤月献计，只要散播张遮命中克妻的谣言，姚家即可退亲，姜雪宁听后教训了尤月一顿。姜雪宁让尤芳吟找许文益买下生丝，静候时机。周寅之在侯府暗查时，竟发现了平南王的徽记残片…

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 2049
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 103
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 10
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 28
programme.desc: 第二十八集定垚不明白启堂为何急于收购超级电池，直至知道天生对电池也有兴趣。程凯设计Q版程序向定垚示爱，坚持只要自己还喜欢她，就不会答应合作。高哲挽救了思妤的绿色产业，思妤萌生与他复合想法。泽雨随安东、日朗推广端儿的烹饪平台，意外发现二人只是骗子；泽雨、端儿为梦想破灭而失落。程凯决定和天生签约，启堂的反应平常令定垚起疑。定垚终发现启堂的计划，打算牺牲程凯拖垮天生。

programme.desc: 全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 / The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5) Episode 4
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎(鼎爷)武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当「耍家」！鼎爷设立「阿爷厨房」，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜、汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以「抵食价」煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃「香喷喷」煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 463
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.desc: 第10集 请秘书为何那样（下）杨帆识破碧池等人安排希灵出任其秘书的用意，却毫不在意，一心只想物色能为他带来庞大利益的得力助手，并视范特栖为最佳人选。他利诱范特栖加盟跨世代，却遭对方拒绝。范特栖亲近张太原来另有目的，为达到目标付出不少努力，讵料……杨帆在范特栖最落魄之时出手相助，范特栖认为杨帆只想利用他的外表优势谋取利益，杨帆设法说服他，成功将其罗致旗下。另一方面，希灵正式上班，文谦、碧池等人惊觉她的工作岗位竟有变动……

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 / Mrs. Revenge Episode 15
programme.desc: 第15集幸如恍然雪文一直处心积虑要抢走她的一切。雪文为报复继威，向家谦告发他与其昌收受回佣……幸如再次胃痛入院，担心会像梦境般患癌。浩恩打算放弃追求幸如，熙妍却鼓励他坚持。幸如得悉雪文一事，希望藉此撮合她跟继威结婚。家谦、启荣就其昌的去留争论，兄弟斗争升温。QMC的客户突然接连解约，家谦面临业绩压力。佩贞得知雪文之事，催促继威讨回雪文的欢心。幸如使计令继威的钱债压力加剧，又故意刺激雪文，以加速二人结婚。

programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌。发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食。转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像。亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅。位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态。来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 2205
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 104
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 平安谷之诡谷传说 / Forgotten Valley, The Episode 15
programme.desc: 第15集水雄带保甲来到大屋的前后门看守。至半夜，戴着面谱的人从菜箩爬出，北杏此时也从枱底走出来，二人在黑暗中发生碰撞。水雄带保甲寻凶，误中水丰和天佑设计的天罗地网。立秋母亲要求不再追究，但水丰坚持缉凶，还他和立秋公道。桂思到庙内感谢初一、鸣凤等助水丰脱险，七人滴血为盟。初一到溪涧洗衣服，听到高兴嫂指水富开始学走路；初一做了新鞋，托水丰带给水富。水丰带水富与初一见面，桂思打开小璇的画簿见到面谱图画，水丰认得偷证物的人戴同一款面谱，怀疑绑架小璇与杀立秋者是同一人，天佑亦察觉小璇见茉莉花感到惶恐。

programme.title: 平安谷之诡谷传说 / Forgotten Valley, The Episode 16
programme.desc: 第16集水雄翌日入牢房时发现正月上吊身亡，水雄判定正月是杀立秋和绑架小璇的凶手。淼淼到溪涧洗冬笋时掉到水中，被学文救起。学文误闯义庄遇桂思，原来是桂思邀请他到平安谷教书。水丰陪学文到墟市宣扬科学，吸引村民好奇观看；村民听到男子与女子一起读书，齐声反对；惟明使计令村民让女孩到私塾上课。初一意外发现曼仪用药滑胎，曼仪要他保守秘密，否则对水富不利。鸣凤求神庇佑小璇，三姑危言耸听，指有人用厌胜术令小璇痴呆；鸣凤跟踪曼仪到树林，更知道曼仪的秘密。鸣凤趁曼仪离家入她房间搜索，找出德怀给曼仪的血书……

programme.desc: 各类骗案数字持续上升，涉及的款项亦甚夸张。据悉香港每日平均损失达2500万元，每13分钟就有一宗骗案发生……网购、求职、投资、交友应用程序、电话骗案等行骗招数越来越高明，市民要及时提高防骗意识，慎防中伏！主持区永权、萧正楠、李旻芳、梁敏巧网罗不同真实个案，深入了解事主被骗经过，节目还会以故事形式重现个中情节。专家们现身拆解不同犯案手法，协助观众辨识《呃钱》陷阱，避免成为骗徒目标！

programme.title: 鹿鼎记 / Royal Tramp
programme.desc: 满清发迹于关外鹿飞山，入主中原初期，康熙年幼，满洲第一勇士鳌拜当权，以反清复明为志的陈近南，组织了「天地会」，多次暗杀鳌拜不成。一次「天地会」聚会，被鳌拜手下围捕，幸得小龟奴韦小宝之助才能脱险，陈近南叫小宝入会，命他设法混进清宫，小宝走错门路，几乎被阉为太监，还好大太监海公公包庇他，才免了一刀之灾。海公公叫小宝监视太后，小宝偏和皇帝和公主建宁打架，变成皇帝的心腹，皇帝叫小宝去杀鳌拜不成，追杀时，太后救了小宝；原来太后是假的，原是神龙教教徒，卧底清宫设法盗取大内至宝四十二章经……

programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视 & 社畜求生101 / News Magazine 2026 & Yes, Boss. Episode 34
programme.desc: 《新闻透视》，每周专题报导多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士、学者、专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 234
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港系列之细间始终你好 / Hong Kong: Never Too Small Episode 10
programme.desc: 在时代浪潮的冲刷下，描绘着城市缩影的本地小店越来越少，它们却是建构城市的重要部份，也是无可取替的香港精神。有见及此，「贴地」主持人阮兆祥引领观众一店一探秘，到访衣、食、住、行四大民生领域的老字号、新派小店，带出店铺的经营历史、守业辛酸，娓娓道来几代人背后的故事，以有形小店留下无形回忆，呈现「细间」始终美好！

programme.title: 唱钱 / Music Money Monster Episode 28
programme.desc: 挑战音域的极限、拍子的精准，全新互动音乐游戏节目《唱钱》由森美、Eric Kwok、李茵彤任主持，以专业音准分析系统考验参赛者。九宫格代表九个难度等级，参赛者每当连成一线「过三关」，可选择提款离场、继续挑战，甚至是最难的Monster关卡。一旦过关失败，奖金即归零！素人版独自闯关，力争最高十万元奖金。明星版为观众谋福利，而观众参与直播间互动，狂揿Emoji为参赛歌手打气，同时有机会赢取奖金、礼品。

programme.title: J Music / J Music 2026 Episode 121
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高质音乐平台，一众歌手有展示音乐实力的机会之余，也可让乐迷更深入了解歌手的音乐故事。节目邀请「人气」歌手担任嘉宾，由嘉宾亲自挑选其喜欢的新旧作品，并即场演唱，分享喜爱曲目。而一些乐坛新面孔亦会亮相，透过互动交流，展现音乐潜力。此外，每集紧贴「劲歌金榜」最新形势，送上歌曲MV外，还会带来不同歌手、创作人或制作人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至音乐业界的人和事。

programme.title: 中年好声音4决战前夕 / Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4-The Final Countdown
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》歷經近十個月的漫長賽程，全球五大賽區、上百位熱血追夢者角逐的淘汰比拼，在層層篩選下，最終只留下七位頂尖選手。眾人即將於7月23日進軍啟德體藝館，上演閃耀矚目的《登峯之戰》，全城期待。列強對壘前夕，特輯搶先披露參賽者們的備戰機密。各人的「神秘密友」會驚喜現身，揭開好友感性的內心世界，還有一路走來的蛻變過程。節目亦會率先公開決賽的決勝快、慢歌歌單，以及眾人的終極舞台戰衣。

programme.title: 冲游泰国11 / Thai Rogered (Sr.11) Episode 4
programme.desc: 第4集考艾游乐园、曼谷「自助餐天花板」考艾离曼谷约两小时车程，是泰国人的度假热点，冲哥、波波先重点介绍酒店附属的游乐园，打卡位甚多，连绕场一周的游览小火车，沿途也有惊喜位。冬荫表姐细听冲哥推介一间被誉为曼谷自助餐界别的「天花板」餐厅，为何不见美食摆放让人随意挑选？原来是崭新的自助餐模式！以山洞为主题的餐厅，让冲哥也想一探究竟，他与冬荫哥哥还有特别造型！楼上酒吧更有特别景致？此外，冲哥与波波亦会带来四面神的拜神与还神信息。

programme.title: 晚间新闻 / News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT Episode 33
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。

programme.title: 新闻透视 / News Magazine 2026 Episode 34
programme.desc: 《新闻透视》，每周专题报导多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士、学者、专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉。

programme.title: 童你一起长大了 / Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: 从《跳飞机》到《Hands Up》，TVB的儿童节目一直陪伴小朋友成长，缔造出一幕幕美好的童年回忆。资深儿童节目主持谭玉瑛、黎芷珊、盖世宝也「童」你一起长大了！三人会因应每集不同主题，邀请不同年代的主持人欢聚，一起畅谈往昔点滴。数十年过去，当年的小主持、参加者都已成长不少，主持们四出寻人，跟大家重温昔日片段。经典环节「空中畅游」记载着无数快乐回忆，主持们与嘉宾李佳芯会带同新世代小孩体验个中乐趣。

programme.title: 港女野人 / Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: 第1集港女．野人 开动！何泳芍、陈若思、廖慧仪和胡美贻，先后透过港姐竞选入行，今次一同参与真人骚节目，全方位挑战本地不同难度系数的山野。四位活力主持，无惧上山下海、荒岛求生、攀岩觅路，但原来有人事前全无扎营经验，行山居然不带饮用水？摄制组请来山艺教练、野炊达人、环保战士等教路，仍避不过意外，情况有多惊险？四人一起体验野外露营，「驾到边、瞓到边」的车中泊；亲手炮制串烧原只嫩鸡、巨型鲑鱼等野炊美食……由港女变身「野人」！

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 234
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港早晨 / Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 娱乐大家 / Liza's On Line (Sr.2) Episode 2
programme.desc: 「阿姐」汪明荃、森美、苏永康、余德丞联合炮制游戏节目，邀请娱乐家族成员及嘉宾参与「狼人宫廷版」游戏，显露各人愚笨、聪颖的一面。嘉宾还会大讲夸张「真假话题」哗众取宠，事件是真是假先来一番揣测！阿姐承接上辑施展魔法，又在「Cheat Chat」餐桌上带起话题，谁可带来最强的娱乐性？阿姐人面甚广，请到不同领域的嘉宾，计有麦玲玲、薛家燕、何超莲、姜皓文、方力申、钱嘉乐等，一同争取最佳表现及丰富奖品！

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2022 Episode 10
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 1776
programme.desc: 全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 平安谷之诡谷传说 / Forgotten Valley, The Episode 17
programme.desc: 第17集七女子在庙里会面，澄澄责怪鸣凤告发曼仪，鸣凤坚持她是谋害小璇的主谋。五叔公召集村民开会，指责学文的新式教学不知所谓要赶走他。东阳庆祝女儿淼淼生日，命她穿上妻子涓涓的衣服；淼淼离开后东阳命北杏穿上涓涓的衣服，错认她是妻子，抱她上床。惟明不值东阳所为，她与桂思求学文带淼淼到省城，找修女收留。金谷指学文勾引女学生私奔，要被乱石掟死。三姑的孙女吉祥和一班小学生跑出来保护学文和淼淼，众妇女心痛子女被掟石头，群起指骂男人，场面变得混乱；学文劝学生回家，小孩子坚决留守。

programme.title: 平安谷之诡谷传说 / Forgotten Valley, The Episode 18
programme.desc: 第18集尚舜向曼仪示爱，并指已计划带她远走高飞。初一到庙求神，发现鸣凤取了一百大洋及留下借据。初一告知北杏，北杏怀疑鸣凤跟男人私奔。鸣凤带小璇到与天佑约定的地点相会，却被水雄追截，天佑现身救鸣凤。尚舜推测水丰得知他的秘密后，偷偷复制金谷的一条铜匙，走入火药库。一班妇女在乌家留宿，坚持若不废除女诫誓不回家。金谷命鸣凤到龙门镇收数，实质他收了邻村富户的礼金，暗中安排小璇嫁人。善慈为小璇梳头出嫁，尚舜使走善慈，掳去小璇。鸣凤为救小璇冲入祠堂与尚舜纠缠，小璇挣扎打翻油灯，祠堂瞬间火光熊熊……

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 234
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2026 Episode 316
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 流行经典50年 / Cantopop At 50 Episode 105
programme.desc: 中外乐坛历年来诞生无数金曲，不论甚么年代的作品，皆各有知音人。《流行经典50年》邀请原唱人或实力歌手，再次演绎这些流行一时，兼且跨越多代的经典，为乐迷带来高质素的音乐享受。除了具份量的乐坛前辈之外，不少久未露面的歌手亦应邀在节目现身，献给观众多重惊喜。
